stories.title: WNBA playoffs: How Ogunbowale's historic 45 points saved the Wings' season
stories.summary: Dallas rallied to force a decisive Game 3 and Arike Ogunbowale made history.

stories.title: Yankees hammer Red Sox again to cruise into ALDS
stories.summary: The Yankees finished their AL Wild Card Series outscoring the Red Sox 18-2 in a dominate display against their division rivals.

stories.title: Steelers to trade CB Porter to Cowboys for pair of picks, sources say
stories.summary: The Steelers have agreed to trade cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources confirmed to ESPN on Wednesday night.

stories.title: Ogunbowale saves Wings' season, breaks playoff record with 45 in OT classic
stories.summary: Arike Ogunbowale delivered a record-breaking performance with the Wings' season on the line, scoring 45 points, including a tying 3-pointer to force overtime, to help Dallas force a deciding Game 3 against the Valkyries.

stories.title: White Sox continue to 'believe,' score 1st playoff series win since 2005
stories.summary: Just two years removed from a 121-loss season, the White Sox finished off the Astros with a 7-3 win Wednesday to secure their first playoff series win since beating Houston in the 2005 World Series.
